title: Echo: voice and bones survive the body
original_description: Ovid, Metamorphoses III: Echo's body disappears while her voice survives and her bones become stone. The wording closely resembles R6's 'body ... remains ... gone'. A November 13 community theory proposed this reading. This is a literary parallel, not an observed R6 mechanic.
original_gap: No in-game identity, assembly of voice/bones or selected item. The wording match does not prove intended Ovid reference.
original_group_hint: Stories & mythology / Echo

original_description: An operational branch of N007: Echo repeats the end of someone else's speech. The proposed Hunt action is repeating a player's chat or using a two-person call-and-response at the lake. The historical item/music experiments do not establish this chat procedure.
original_gap: No exact phrase, required players, chat parsing evidence or verified R6-specific response. Should not be tested at random without a stronger selector.

title: Orpheus: lyre, surviving song and river
original_description: In Ovid's Metamorphoses XI, Orpheus's head and lyre pass down a river to the sea after his death, with song or sound continuing. November 13 reports used Melody's Hair/Personal Harp, a Tuning Fork and various helmets under Better Together; this did not isolate an Orpheus-specific clue.
original_gap: A mythological parallel is not a chosen in-game recipe. Playing DEFAG is not evidence that Orpheus used these notes; item experiments mixed many variables.
original_group_hint: Stories & mythology / Orpheus

title: Melody's destroyed harp and The Rebuild
original_description: Melody says a storm broke her harp and the player brings 512 Acacia Logs so she can rebuild the base using string she already owns. Kalevala Runo 40/44 offer a separate lost-in-water and rebuilt-kantele comparison (R055). Later tests played uncertain Melody's Hair notes and dropped harp/head items, but did not document an R6-active harp-reconstruction event.
original_gap: The quest does not say its existing string survived the storm; no evidence connects this one-time repair to the lake. The failed music/item test does not cover the repair itself.
original_group_hint: Stories & mythology / Musical instruments

title: DEFAGB with Better Together: event and note sequence
original_description: A compound branch linking R003 (offering initials DEFAG), R036 (Better Together) and R097 (seven natural notes). One proposal: B is Better Together, giving DEFAGB, played during the event or immediately after it ends. November 13 tests reported DEFAG using a Tuning Fork and uncertain Melody's Hair notes during an active event, alongside item drops. The specific six-note sequence/event-end combination was not documented.
original_gap: No established reason why playing notes should register for R6, why Better Together should supply B, or why C is reserved for R7. Existing report mixed items and did not show a controlled before/after event-end check.
original_group_hint: Patterns & messages / Better Together and notes
